summary.text: John Jasinski is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 19 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Sam Powell.
He is a real estate broker who has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Jasinski earned a bachelor's degree from Minnesota State University, Mankato.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.

According to Ballotpedia, Jasinski's 2016 campaign website highlighted conservative values, keeping jobs and people in Minnesota, improving Greater Minnesota's roads and bridges, creating jobs in Greater Minnesota, and welfare reform.
